summary: Transform the SpendCube dashboard from a developer tool into a client-presentable procurement analytics product. This sprint addresses 10 identified issues: developer-facing strings ('make build-cube', 'dry_run=true') exposed in the UI, no client branding, default Streamlit theme, sparse homepage, no data freshness indicator, absent page descriptions, hardcoded 'AUD' currency labels, and the Review Workstation analyst tool being visible to clients. No auth, data upload, or new analytics features — this sprint is pure polish and professionalism. The result should be a dashboard that can be opened in front of a CPO without embarrassment.

decisions.client_config_location: Add a 'client:' block to the existing config.yaml (already used for all configuration). A new dashboard/client_config.py module reads this block and exposes helpers used by all dashboard pages. This avoids a separate config file and is consistent with the existing pattern.
decisions.review_workstation_visibility: Rename dashboard/pages/07_review_workstation.py to dashboard/pages/99_admin_review_workstation.py. Streamlit file-based routing shows pages alphabetically/numerically, so '99_' pushes it to the bottom. Add a prominent red banner at the top of the page: 'INTERNAL ANALYST TOOL — not for client distribution'. This is the simplest reversible approach without auth.
decisions.streamlit_theme: Create .streamlit/config.toml with a professional dark-navy primary colour (#1B4F72), white background, and light grey secondary background. No logo file — text-based branding only for now. This avoids image asset management.
decisions.developer_string_replacement: All 'Run make build-cube', 'Run the full pipeline', 'dry_run=true or LLM skipped', and 'Procurement analytics pipeline' strings are replaced with client-appropriate equivalents: 'Data not yet loaded — contact your analyst to refresh.' and 'Narrative not available for this recommendation.'
decisions.data_freshness: Compute last ingestion date from the max(ingested_at) field in transactions.parquet. Show on homepage as 'Data last refreshed: DD Month YYYY'. ingested_at is stored as ISO string, parse with pd.to_datetime.
decisions.currency_label: Add base_currency to client_config.py, reading from config.yaml spend_cube.base_currency (already exists, value='AUD'). All hardcoded 'AUD' strings in dashboard pages replaced with the config value.

existing_tables.transactions_parquet: data/output/transactions.parquet — 50 columns. Key fields for this sprint: ingested_at (ISO string, use for data freshness), base_currency (string), base_amount. All 5210 rows have same ingested_at = '2026-04-09T22:37:50.234164'.
existing_tables.config_yaml: config.yaml — root-level config file. Has 'spend_cube.base_currency: AUD'. Will gain a new 'client:' block with name, engagement, currency_label fields.

key_files: config.yaml — add client: name, engagement, currency_label block
dashboard/app.py — main entry, homepage, load_cube_data(). Update branding, homepage content, data freshness.
dashboard/client_config.py — NEW FILE. Reads config.yaml client: block and exposes get_client_name(), get_engagement_title(), get_currency_label(), get_data_freshness_date().
dashboard/pages/01_spend_overview.py — remove developer strings, add page description, replace AUD with currency label
dashboard/pages/02_category_deep_dive.py — remove developer strings, add page description
dashboard/pages/03_supplier_deep_dive.py — remove developer strings, add page description
dashboard/pages/04_payment_terms.py — remove developer strings, add page description
dashboard/pages/05_data_quality.py — remove developer strings (make build-cube, data/output path), add page description
dashboard/pages/06_recommendations.py — remove 'dry_run=true or LLM skipped', remove 'Run make build-cube', add page description

patterns_to_follow: config.yaml is the single source of truth for all configuration. New client: block follows the same flat-key YAML pattern as existing blocks.
dashboard/client_config.py reads config.yaml using the same pyyaml pattern as other src/ modules. Returns defaults if keys are missing.
All dashboard pages use absolute paths via Path(__file__). client_config.py should use Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'config.yaml' to locate the config.
Streamlit page titles use st.title() at the top of each page's main() function. Add st.caption() immediately after for the page description — this is the lightest-touch approach.

The review workstation rename: after renaming to 99_admin_review_workstation.py, the page label in Streamlit sidebar becomes 'Admin Review Workstation'. Add st.error() banner at top of main() to mark it as internal.

userStories.title: Create dashboard/client_config.py module
userStories.description: Create a new module dashboard/client_config.py that reads the 'client:' block from config.yaml and exposes clean helper functions used by all dashboard pages. Also computes data freshness date from transactions.parquet. This is the single place all pages call for branding and config values — no page should read config.yaml directly.
acceptanceCriteria:
Create file: dashboard/client_config.py with the following functions. All functions return sensible defaults if config.yaml is missing or malformed. Use Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'config.yaml' to locate the config file.

  get_client_name() -> str: returns client.name from config.yaml. If empty string or missing, returns empty string.

  get_engagement_title() -> str: returns client.engagement from config.yaml. Default: 'Procurement Spend Diagnostic'.

  get_currency_label() -> str: returns client.currency_label from config.yaml. Fallback: read spend_cube.base_currency. Default: 'AUD'.

  get_page_header(page_title: str) -> str: if get_client_name() is non-empty, return f'{get_client_name()} — {page_title}', else return page_title.

  get_data_freshness(data_dir: Path = None) -> str: reads data/output/transactions.parquet, gets max(ingested_at), parses with pd.to_datetime, formats as 'DD Month YYYY' (e.g. '09 April 2026'). If file missing or error, returns 'Unknown'. data_dir defaults to Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'data' / 'output'.

Run: PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) python3 -c "from dashboard.client_config import get_client_name, get_engagement_title, get_currency_label, get_page_header, get_data_freshness; print(get_engagement_title()); print(get_currency_label()); print(get_page_header('Spend Overview')); print(get_data_freshness())" — should print without error and show 'Procurement Spend Diagnostic', 'AUD', 'Spend Overview' (no client name set yet), and a date string.

risks: git mv for the review workstation rename — if Ralph uses a plain file rename instead of git mv, git will show it as delete+add rather than a rename. The acceptance criteria explicitly says 'git mv' to avoid this.

get_currency_label() is used in f-strings inside KPI metric labels. Some labels are formatted like 'Total Spend (AUD)' — straightforward string replacement. But some are dynamic like f'AUD {value:,.0f}' in payment terms table — Ralph must find and update these too. The verification grep for 'AUD' hardcodes would catch any misses, but Ralph should also check dynamically rendered strings.

st.set_page_config() must be the first Streamlit call in app.py. The current code already does this. client_config imports must not trigger any Streamlit calls — client_config.py must be pure Python with no streamlit import.
